email.subject: Tidewell Health - Backend Engineer: take-home and technical interview
email.body:
Hi,

Thanks for your time on the intro call. We'd like to move you forward for the Backend Engineer role at Tidewell Health.

The next stage has two parts:
1. A short take-home exercise (about 2 hours). You'll get the instructions from our test platform shortly; please submit it by Sunday, 8 November 2026.
2. A technical interview on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 at 16:00, where we'll go through your solution together and talk about API design.

Please confirm that the interview time works for you.

Thanks,
Grace Whitfield
Technical Recruiter
